  `python scripts/project_context_sync.py --project <target> --mode pull` 호출합니다.
- 최종 구현(프로젝트 해석/DB pull): [scripts/project_context_sync.py](/C:/Project/agent-factory/scripts/project_context_sync.py):65-127, 500-522
